q.en: Can you style and run an engagement party in a private Perth backyard?

a.en: Yes. We transform private homes and gardens across Perth Metro with clear-span marquees, festoon lighting, mobile bars, RSA bartenders, grazing tables, and full furniture hire.

q.en: What is the best catering style for a 60 to 150 guest engagement party?

a.en: Cocktail canapés paired with an artisan grazing table or substantial bowl food is our most popular format for Perth engagement celebrations, keeping the atmosphere relaxed and social.

q.en: Do you provide digital invitations for engagement parties?

a.en: Yes. You can send personalised WhatsApp and SMS links with animated wax-seal reveals, collect dietary needs, and share a live photo wall on the night.
